summary: The customer wants to assess whether a fiber-based optical measurement in the feed frame can monitor API concentration changes in a powder blend.

facts_stated.text: They manufacture tablets from a powder blend containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient and excipients.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We manufacture tablets from a powder blend containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient and excipients.

facts_stated.text: Laboratory checks assess if the blend is on target, but results arrive too late after material moves through the press.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Laboratory checks tell us whether the blend is on target, but results arrive after the material has moved through the press.

facts_stated.text: They want to run a pilot comparing measurement options before committing to production equipment.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Our first pilot should compare reasonable measurement options before we commit to production equipment.

heterogeneous.enquiry_quote: powder blend containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient and excipients

customer_premises.claim: A fiber-based measurement located in the feed frame can successfully follow API concentration changes.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: whether a fiber based measurement in the feed frame could follow API concentration changes
